body_edits.diff:
@ImanSharaf just added our first mention of type confusion in [10.4.1](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/184bcc511af54245e33e4aaf9a9855206a58b98d/5.0/en/0x18-V10-Coding.md?plain=1#L59). We had a discussion around where type confusion manifests, and I'd like to cover the scenario where we get type confusion as a result of deserializing untrusted data. 

In [this CVE](https://bishopfox.com/blog/cve-2019-18935-remote-code-execution-in-telerik-ui) for example, attackers were able to specify an arbitrary object in the `rauPostData` param which allowed them to deserialize an RCE gadget; this would have been prevented with a serialization binder.

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---:| :---: | :---: |
| **5.5.1** | Verify that deserialization processes enforce strict binding to predefined, safe data types only, to prevent attackers from injecting malicious gadget classes that could lead to type confusion and unauthorized code execution.|  | ✓ | ✓ | 704 |
